errors.evidence: The description states the y-axis tick labels have an interval of 1% or 2%, which is ambiguous. The labels shown on the axis (-1, 1, 3, 5, etc.) are at a consistent interval of 2%.

The description states the blue solid line ends at approximately 6.3% in 2024. According to the chart, the line ends at a value of approximately 3.5%. The value 6.3% is the constant average shown by the dashed blue line.
The description states that the purple solid line drops to -0.5% in 2008. In the chart, the value in 2008 is approximately +0.5%. The line drops to approximately -0.5% in the year 2014, not 2008.
The description states the purple solid line ends at approximately 2.1% in 2024. The chart shows this line ending at a much lower value, around 0.5%.
